import Main
import Eggshell.ContractAudit
import tools.SharedCoverageInput
import tools.research.CoverageExchange
import tools.research.AvailableDelivery
open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.Research Eggshell.Synapses Eggshell.Synapses.CanonicalSource
#print axioms SharedCoverage.Exchange.strictly_better
#print axioms SharedCoverage.Exchange.keeps_limits
namespace CoverageExchangeProbe
def check (condition : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit :=
  unless condition do throw (IO.userError message)
def read (path : String) : IO Json := IO.FS.readFile (.mk path) >>= (IO.ofExcept ∘ Json.parse)
def fixture (costs : Array (Nat × Nat)) (weights : Array Nat)
    (offers : Array SharedCoverage.Input.RawOffer) (limit : Nat × Nat) : IO Unit := do
  let p ← IO.ofExcept (SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem.mk costs weights offers (0,0) limit).decode
  let some empty := SharedCoverage.empty? p | throw (IO.userError "fixture has no empty selection")
  let some first := (List.finRange p.offers.size)[0]? | throw (IO.userError "fixture first offer missing")
  let some second := (List.finRange p.offers.size)[1]? | throw (IO.userError "fixture second offer missing")
  let some one := SharedCoverage.extend? empty first | throw (IO.userError "fixture first offer does not fit")
  let some prior := SharedCoverage.extend? one second | throw (IO.userError "fixture second offer does not fit")
  let result := SharedCoverage.Exchange.search prior
  check (result.proposal.isSome == result.checked.isSome) "fast exchange failed independent certification"
  let value := (result.checked.map (fun choice => SharedCoverage.benefit p choice.result.selected)).getD
    (SharedCoverage.benefit p prior.selected)
  let mut expected := SharedCoverage.benefit p prior.selected
  for added in List.finRange p.offers.size do
    if prior.selected.contains added then continue
    for dropped in prior.selected do
      let next := prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added]
      let charge := SharedCoverage.cost p next
      if charge.1 ≤ p.limit.1 && charge.2 ≤ p.limit.2 then expected := max expected (SharedCoverage.benefit p next)
  check (value == expected) "counted exchange differs from exhaustive original-objective evaluation"
def tests : IO Unit := do
  fixture #[(1,1),(1,1),(1,1)] #[1,1,10]
    #[⟨[0],[0]⟩,⟨[1],[1]⟩,⟨[2],[2]⟩] (2,2)
  fixture #[(10,10),(1,1),(1,1),(1,1)] #[2,2,9]
    #[⟨[0,0,1],[0]⟩,⟨[0,2],[1]⟩,⟨[0,3],[2]⟩] (12,12)
  fixture #[(1,1),(1,1),(1,1)] #[3,100,9]
    #[⟨[0],[0,1,1]⟩,⟨[1],[1]⟩,⟨[2],[1,2]⟩] (2,2)
  fixture #[(1,2),(1,2),(1,3)] #[1,2,10^100]
    #[⟨[0],[0]⟩,⟨[1],[1]⟩,⟨[2],[2]⟩] (2,4)
def run (diagnostic evidence output : String) : IO Unit := do
  check (!(← System.FilePath.pathExists output)) "preserve the fixed-objective exchange audit"
  tests
  let capture := (← read diagnostic).getObjValD "signals/diagnostic/selection.json"
  let raw : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem ← IO.ofExcept (capture.getObjValAs? _ "selectorInput")
  let p ← IO.ofExcept raw.decode
  let witness := capture.getObjValD "selectionWitness"
  let sourceNodes : Array (Nat × Key) ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "sourceNodes")
  let actual : Array Nat ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "selectedSourceNodes")
  let some baseline := SharedCoverage.OwnedAdvance.chooseOwned p | throw (IO.userError "captured problem has no selection")
  let selectedRows := fun indices => Id.run do
    let membership := Std.HashSet.ofList ((SharedCoverage.nodes p indices).map (·.val))
    return sourceNodes.filterMap fun (node,key) => if membership.contains node then some key else none
  let before := selectedRows baseline.selected
  let actualSet := Std.HashSet.ofArray actual
  let beforeIds := Std.HashSet.ofList ((SharedCoverage.nodes p baseline.selected).map (·.val))
  check (before.size == actualSet.size && actual.all beforeIds.contains) "baseline differs from actual source atoms"
  let started ← IO.monoMsNow
  let result := SharedCoverage.Exchange.search baseline
  let elapsed := (← IO.monoMsNow)-started
  check (result.proposal.isSome == result.checked.isSome) "best exchange failed independent full recomputation"
  let next := (result.checked.map (·.result.selected)).getD baseline.selected
  let after := selectedRows next
  -- The labels are unavailable to the exhaustive objective search above.
  let frozen : AvailableDelivery.Frozen ← IO.ofExcept
    ((((← read evidence).getObjValD "llvm/before-delivery.json").getObjValD "topics").getArr? >>= fun topics =>
      (topics[0]?.getD Json.null).getObjValAs? _ "frozen")
  let ranges := fun (rows : Array Key) => rows.map fun key => (⟨.file key.file,key.line,key.line⟩ : Range)
  let proposal := result.proposal.map fun choice => Json.mkObj [("dropped",toJson choice.dropped.val),
    ("added",toJson choice.added.val),("cost",toJson choice.cost),("benefit",toJson (toString choice.value))]
  IO.FS.writeFile (.mk output) (Json.mkObj [("pairs",toJson result.pairs),("feasible",toJson result.feasible),
    ("exchangeMs",toJson elapsed),("certified",toJson result.checked.isSome),("proposal",toJson proposal),
    ("before",toJson (AvailableDelivery.assess frozen (ranges before))),
    ("after",toJson (AvailableDelivery.assess frozen (ranges after))),
    ("beforeCost",toJson (SharedCoverage.cost p baseline.selected)),("afterCost",toJson (SharedCoverage.cost p next)),
    ("beforeBenefit",toJson (toString (SharedCoverage.benefit p baseline.selected))),
    ("afterBenefit",toJson (toString (SharedCoverage.benefit p next))),
    ("baselineActualNodesReproduced",toJson true),("independentFixtureChecks",toJson (4 : Nat)),
    ("originalProblemUnchanged",toJson true),("labelsReadAfterSelection",toJson true),
    ("productChanged",toJson false),("queryOrModelCalled",toJson false),("adopted",toJson false)]).compress
end CoverageExchangeProbe
def main : List String → IO Unit
  | [diagnostic,evidence,output] => CoverageExchangeProbe.run diagnostic evidence output
  | _ => throw (IO.userError "CoverageExchangeProbe DIAGNOSTIC EVIDENCE OUTPUT")

module
public import tools.SharedCoverage
@[expose] public section
namespace SharedCoverage.Exchange
variable {p : Problem} {prior : Selection p}
structure Proposal (p : Problem) where
  dropped : Fin p.offers.size
  added : Fin p.offers.size
  cost : Nat × Nat
  value : Nat

structure Improvement (prior : Selection p) where
  result : Selection p
  proposal : Proposal p
  removed : proposal.dropped ∈ prior.selected
  fresh : proposal.added ∉ prior.selected
  shape : result.selected = prior.selected.filter (· != proposal.dropped) ++ [proposal.added]
  costExact : cost p result.selected = proposal.cost
  valueExact : benefit p result.selected = proposal.value
  better : benefit p prior.selected < benefit p result.selected

def check? (prior : Selection p) (proposal : Proposal p) : Option (Improvement prior) :=
  if permitted : proposal.dropped ∈ prior.selected ∧ proposal.added ∉ prior.selected then
    let selected := prior.selected.filter (· != proposal.dropped) ++ [proposal.added]
    if unique : selected.Nodup then
      if bounded : (cost p selected).1 ≤ p.limit.1 ∧ (cost p selected).2 ≤ p.limit.2 then
        if exactCost : cost p selected = proposal.cost then
          if exactValue : benefit p selected = proposal.value then
            if better : benefit p prior.selected < benefit p selected then
              some ⟨⟨selected,unique,bounded.1,bounded.2⟩,proposal,permitted.1,permitted.2,rfl,exactCost,exactValue,better⟩
            else none
          else none
        else none
      else none
    else none
  else none

theorem strictly_better (choice : Improvement prior) :
    benefit p prior.selected < benefit p choice.result.selected := choice.better
theorem keeps_limits (choice : Improvement prior) :
    (cost p choice.result.selected).1 ≤ p.limit.1 ∧ (cost p choice.result.selected).2 ≤ p.limit.2 :=
  ⟨choice.result.charsFit,choice.result.bytesFit⟩

def remainder? (prior : Selection p) (dropped : Fin p.offers.size) : Option (Selection p) :=
  let selected := prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)
  if unique : selected.Nodup then
    if bounded : (cost p selected).1 ≤ p.limit.1 ∧ (cost p selected).2 ≤ p.limit.2 then
      some ⟨selected,unique,bounded.1,bounded.2⟩
    else none
  else none

theorem remainder_selected (found : remainder? prior dropped = some rest) :
    rest.selected = prior.selected.filter (· != dropped) := by
  unfold remainder? at found
  dsimp only at found
  split at found <;> try contradiction
  split at found <;> try contradiction
  cases Option.some.inj found
  rfl

/-- Independent verifier: rebuild each deletion with the original evaluator,
whose marginal cost and benefit already have kernel-checked exactness laws. -/
def verifyRemoval (prior : Selection p) (upper : Nat) (dropped : Fin p.offers.size) : Bool :=
  match remainder? prior dropped with
  | none => false
  | some rest =>
      let cached := evaluation rest
      (List.finRange p.offers.size).all fun added =>
        if added ∈ prior.selected then true
        else if (cached.afterCost added).1 ≤ p.limit.1 ∧ (cached.afterCost added).2 ≤ p.limit.2 then
          decide (cached.afterBenefit added ≤ upper)
        else true

theorem verify_removal_sound (accepted : verifyRemoval prior upper dropped = true)
    (fresh : added ∉ prior.selected)
    (bounded : (cost p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added])).1 ≤ p.limit.1 ∧
      (cost p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added])).2 ≤ p.limit.2) :
    benefit p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added]) ≤ upper := by
  unfold verifyRemoval at accepted
  cases found : remainder? prior dropped with
  | none => simp [found] at accepted
  | some rest =>
    rw [found] at accepted
    dsimp only at accepted
    have decision := List.all_eq_true.mp accepted added (by simp)
    have selected := remainder_selected found
    have actualCost : (evaluation rest).afterCost added = cost p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added]) := by
      simpa [selected] using (evaluation rest).afterCost_exact added
    have actualValue : (evaluation rest).afterBenefit added = benefit p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added]) := by
      simpa [selected] using (evaluation rest).afterBenefit_exact added
    simpa [fresh,actualCost,actualValue,bounded] using decision

structure Certificate (prior : Selection p) where
  upper : Nat
  verified : prior.selected.all (verifyRemoval prior upper) = true

def certify? (prior : Selection p) (upper : Nat) : Option (Certificate prior) :=
  if verified : prior.selected.all (verifyRemoval prior upper) = true then some ⟨upper,verified⟩ else none

theorem all_exchanges_bounded (certificate : Certificate prior) (member : dropped ∈ prior.selected)
    (fresh : added ∉ prior.selected)
    (bounded : (cost p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added])).1 ≤ p.limit.1 ∧
      (cost p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added])).2 ≤ p.limit.2) :
    benefit p (prior.selected.filter (· != dropped)++[added]) ≤ certificate.upper :=
  verify_removal_sound (List.all_eq_true.mp certificate.verified dropped member) fresh bounded

structure Data (p : Problem) where
  index : Fin p.offers.size
  nodes : List (Fin p.costs.size)
  cues : List (Fin p.weights.size)
  nodeSet : Std.HashSet (Fin p.costs.size)
  cueSet : Std.HashSet (Fin p.weights.size)

structure Search (prior : Selection p) where
  proposal : Option (Proposal p)
  checked : Option (Improvement prior)
  pairs : Nat
  feasible : Nat

/-- One exhaustive drop/add pass over the fixed original objective. Counts
refund a shared atom or cue only after its final selected user is removed.
The winner crosses an independent full-cost/full-benefit certificate check. -/
def search (prior : Selection p) : Search prior := Id.run do
  let entries := (List.finRange p.offers.size).toArray.map fun index =>
    let nodes := p.offers[index].closure.eraseDups
    let cues := p.offers[index].covers.eraseDups
    ({index,nodes,cues,nodeSet := Std.HashSet.ofList nodes,cueSet := Std.HashSet.ofList cues} : Data p)
  let selected := Std.HashSet.ofList prior.selected
  let mut nodeCounts : Std.HashMap (Fin p.costs.size) Nat := {}
  let mut cueCounts : Std.HashMap (Fin p.weights.size) Nat := {}
  for index in prior.selected do
    let data := entries[index.val]'(by simp [entries])
    for node in data.nodes do nodeCounts := nodeCounts.insert node ((nodeCounts[node]?.getD 0)+1)
    for cue in data.cues do cueCounts := cueCounts.insert cue ((cueCounts[cue]?.getD 0)+1)
  let sumCost := fun (nodes : List (Fin p.costs.size)) => nodes.foldl (fun total node =>
    (total.1+p.costs[node].1,total.2+p.costs[node].2)) (0,0)
  let old := prior.selected.toArray.map fun index =>
    let data := entries[index.val]'(by simp [entries])
    (index,data.nodes.filter (fun node => nodeCounts[node]? == some 1),
      data.cues.filter (fun cue => cueCounts[cue]? == some 1))
  let beforeCost := cost p prior.selected
  let beforeValue := benefit p prior.selected
  let mut best : Option (Proposal p) := none
  let mut pairs := 0
  let mut feasible := 0
  for next in entries do
    if selected.contains next.index then continue
    let extraCost := sumCost (next.nodes.filter (fun node => !nodeCounts.contains node))
    let extraValue := (next.cues.filter (fun cue => !cueCounts.contains cue)).foldl
      (fun total cue => total+p.weights[cue]) 0
    for (index,exclusiveNodes,exclusiveCues) in old do
      pairs := pairs+1
      let refund := sumCost (exclusiveNodes.filter (fun node => !next.nodeSet.contains node))
      let charge := (beforeCost.1-refund.1+extraCost.1,beforeCost.2-refund.2+extraCost.2)
      if p.limit.1 < charge.1 || p.limit.2 < charge.2 then continue
      feasible := feasible+1
      let lost := (exclusiveCues.filter (fun cue => !next.cueSet.contains cue)).foldl
        (fun total cue => total+p.weights[cue]) 0
      let value := beforeValue-lost+extraValue
      if beforeValue < value && value > ((best.map (·.value)).getD beforeValue) then
        best := some ⟨index,next.index,charge,value⟩
  return ⟨best,best.bind (check? prior),pairs,feasible⟩
end SharedCoverage.Exchange

import Main
import Eggshell.ContractAudit
import tools.research.StudyRuntime
import tools.SharedCoverageInput
import tools.research.AvailableDelivery
open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.DB Eggshell.Research Eggshell.Synapses Eggshell.Synapses.CanonicalSource
namespace ScopeUnionProbe
structure Plan where
  source : String
  sourceFiles : Array (String × String)
  owners : Array String
  expectedHead : Json
  diagnostic : String
  evidence : String
  output : String
  deriving FromJson
def check (condition : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit :=
  unless condition do throw (IO.userError message)
def read (path : String) : IO Json := IO.FS.readFile (.mk path) >>= (IO.ofExcept ∘ Json.parse)
def verify (plan : Plan) : IO Unit := do
  for (name,expected) in plan.sourceFiles do
    check ((← ArtifactHash.hex (.mk plan.source/name)) == expected) "original source bytes changed"
def run (input : String) : IO Unit := do
  let plan ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (α := Plan) (← read input))
  check (!(← System.FilePath.pathExists plan.output)) "preserve the canonical-scope audit"
  verify plan
  let source ← PageMap.pin (.mk plan.source)
  check (toJson source.head == plan.expectedHead) "pinned original head changed"
  let diagnostic ← read plan.diagnostic
  let captured := diagnostic.getObjValD "signals/diagnostic/selection.json"
  check ((diagnostic.getObjValD "signals/diagnostic/validation.json").getObjValD "sameOrdinaryBody" == toJson true)
    "selector witness is not bound to an actual body"
  let raw : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem ← IO.ofExcept (captured.getObjValAs? _ "selectorInput")
  let p ← IO.ofExcept raw.decode
  let witness := captured.getObjValD "selectionWitness"
  let owners : Array String ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "owners")
  check (owners.toList.eraseDups.length == owners.size && owners.size == plan.owners.size &&
    owners.all plan.owners.contains) "query owner domain changed"
  let nodeKeys : Array (Nat × Key) ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "sourceNodes")
  let actualNodes : Array Nat ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "selectedSourceNodes")
  let reader ← Persistence.Store.NodeReader.new source
  let started ← IO.monoMsNow
  let mut merged : Std.HashMap Key StoredRow := {}
  let mut oldExtents : Std.HashSet (File × Nat × Nat) := {}
  let mut observedOwners := 0
  for entry in ← Build.entries source do
    let document ← Build.document reader entry.id
    unless owners.contains document.owner do continue
    observedOwners := observedOwners+1
    let original ← if document.native then do
      let (registry,_) ← addPublishedDocument source entry.id document {} {}
      IO.ofExcept (Recipe.compile registry.store)
    else pure (⟨#[],[]⟩ : Recipe.Stored)
    let layout ← IO.ofExcept (Recipe.check original.rows original.records)
    let metadata := PreparedSourceView.ownerStored document.owner original layout
    for (file,extents) in metadata.scopes do
      for extent in extents do oldExtents := oldExtents.insert (file,extent.first,extent.last)
    for row in original.rows do
      if let some previous := merged[row.key]? then
        check (previous.code == row.code) "original canonical aliases disagree"
        merged := merged.insert row.key {previous with
          origins := (hashDistinct (previous.origins.toList++row.origins.toList)).toArray}
      else merged := merged.insert row.key row
  check (observedOwners == owners.size && merged.size == nodeKeys.size) "source projection differs from actual domain"
  let sourceRows ← nodeKeys.mapM fun (node,key) => do
    let some row := merged[key]? | throw (IO.userError "actual source atom has no original")
    check (p.costs[node]? == some ((Packet.rowText row).length,(Packet.rowText row).utf8ByteSize))
      "original row differs from captured rendering cost"
    if h : node < p.costs.size then return (row,(⟨node,h⟩ : Fin p.costs.size))
    else throw (IO.userError "source atom escaped the finite cost domain")
  let mut firstAtoms : Std.HashMap File Nat := {}
  for (row,node) in sourceRows do
    firstAtoms := firstAtoms.insert row.key.file (min node.val (firstAtoms[row.key.file]?.getD node.val))
  let mut frames : Std.HashMap File (Fin p.costs.size) := {}
  for (file,first) in firstAtoms.toArray do
    let rows := sourceRows.filterMap fun (row,_) => if row.key.file == file then some row else none
    let frame := Packet.fileFrame file rows
    let text := frame.leading++frame.trailing
    check (first > 0 && p.costs[first-1]? == some (text.length,text.utf8ByteSize)) "captured source frame cost differs"
    if h : first-1 < p.costs.size then frames := frames.insert file ⟨first-1,h⟩
    else throw (IO.userError "source frame escaped its finite cost domain")
  let some baseline := SharedCoverage.OwnedAdvance.chooseOwned p | throw (IO.userError "baseline selector rejected")
  let before := Std.HashSet.ofList ((SharedCoverage.nodes p baseline.selected).map (·.val))
  let reproduced := nodeKeys.filterMap fun (node,_) => if before.contains node then some node else none
  let actual := Std.HashSet.ofArray actualNodes
  check (reproduced.size == actual.size && reproduced.all actual.contains) "native replay differs from actual source selection"
  let construction ← IO.monoMsNow
  let some prepared := ScopeAlternatives.prepareUsingFrames p owners.size sourceRows {} frames |
    throw (IO.userError "canonical scope preparation rejected original rows")
  let additional := prepared.scopes.filter fun scope => !oldExtents.contains (scope.first.file,scope.first.line,scope.last.line)
  for scope in additional do
    let paid := Std.HashSet.ofList scope.offer.closure
    check (scope.contained.all fun index => p.offers[index].closure.all paid.contains)
      "new scope obtained credit without original payload conditions"
  let constructionMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-construction
  let candidate : SharedCoverage.Problem := {p with offers := p.offers++additional.map (·.offer)}
  check ((candidate.offers.extract 0 p.offers.size).map SharedCoverage.Input.ofOffer == raw.offers &&
    candidate.costs == p.costs && candidate.weights == p.weights && candidate.limit == p.limit && candidate.fixed == p.fixed)
    "canonical scope changed original offers, costs, values or bounds"
  let beganChoice ← IO.monoMsNow
  let some chosen := SharedCoverage.OwnedAdvance.chooseOwned candidate | throw (IO.userError "canonical-scope selector rejected")
  let chosenMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-beganChoice
  let after := Std.HashSet.ofList ((SharedCoverage.nodes candidate chosen.selected).map (·.val))
  let ranges := fun (selected : Std.HashSet Nat) => sourceRows.filterMap fun (row,atom) =>
    if selected.contains atom.val then some (⟨.file row.key.file,row.key.line,row.key.line⟩ : Range) else none
  -- Frozen labels enter only after both deterministic selections finish.
  let evidence ← read plan.evidence
  let frozen : AvailableDelivery.Frozen ← IO.ofExcept
    (((evidence.getObjValD "llvm/before-delivery.json").getObjValD "topics").getArr? >>= fun topics =>
      (topics[0]?.getD Json.null).getObjValAs? _ "frozen")
  let assessedBefore := AvailableDelivery.assess frozen (ranges before)
  let assessedAfter := AvailableDelivery.assess frozen (ranges after)
  let expected := ((evidence.getObjValD "llvm/result.json").getObjValD "queries").getArr?.toOption.getD #[]
  check (toJson assessedBefore == ((expected[0]?.getD Json.null).getObjValD "assessment").getObjValD "availableDelivery")
    "canonical baseline coverage differs from independently audited actual body"
  verify plan
  let newScopes := additional.map fun scope => Json.mkObj [("first",toJson scope.first),("last",toJson scope.last),
    ("rows",toJson scope.rows),("containedOffers",toJson scope.contained.length)]
  IO.FS.writeFile (.mk plan.output) (Json.mkObj [("sourceHead",toJson source.head),
    ("owners",toJson owners.size),("originalRows",toJson merged.size),("ownerExtents",toJson oldExtents.size),
    ("canonicalScopesRecognized",toJson prepared.recognized),("canonicalScopesAffordable",toJson prepared.scopes.size),
    ("additionalScopes",toJson newScopes),("constructionMs",toJson constructionMs),("selectionMs",toJson chosenMs),
    ("baselineActualNodesReproduced",toJson true),("originalProblemUnchanged",toJson true),
    ("before",toJson assessedBefore),("after",toJson assessedAfter),
    ("beforeCost",toJson (SharedCoverage.cost p baseline.selected)),
    ("afterCost",toJson (SharedCoverage.cost candidate chosen.selected)),
    ("selectedNewScopes",toJson (chosen.selected.filter (fun index => p.offers.size ≤ index.val) |>.map (·.val))),
    ("elapsedMs",toJson ((← IO.monoMsNow)-started)),("sourceHashesBeforeAndAfter",toJson true),
    ("actualDeliveryAsserted",toJson false),("queryOrModelCalled",toJson false),("cacheCreated",toJson false),
    ("productChanged",toJson false),("adopted",toJson false)]).compress
end ScopeUnionProbe
def main : List String → IO Unit
  | [input] => ScopeUnionProbe.run input
  | _ => throw (IO.userError "ScopeUnionProbe PLAN")
